target.name: runtime-installed IWRAM block memory routines
target.role: block copy and block fill in 4-byte and 2-byte units, installed in IWRAM at boot and reached through ROM Thumb-to-ARM veneers
target.notes: THE FIRST ARM TARGET AND THE FIRST RUNTIME-INSTALLED ONE. The arm7tdmi reset code at 0x080000C0 programs DMA3 twice: first with SAD = SP (the single zero word it pushes), DAD = 0x03001004 and CNT 0x850010BE, a 32-bit source-fixed zero fill of 17144 bytes; then with SAD 0x087B79A4, DAD 0x03000000 and CNT 0x84000401, a 32-bit block copy of 0x401 words = 4100 bytes. The second copy is verbatim, so IWRAM 0x03000000 + k holds ROM 0x087B79A4 + k and the whole block is statically known. 4100 is not assumed: it is the reading that ends both at the first byte of the 0xFF fill in ROM (0x087B89A8) and at the destination of the first DMA in IWRAM (0x03001004), while the 16-bit reading would leave eight of the thirteen veneer destinations outside the copied block; both candidates are reported. THE FOUR FUNCTIONS ARE THE BLOCK-MEMORY FAMILY OF THAT BLOCK: 0x087B810C copy (IWRAM 0x03000768, reached by the veneer at 0x08049138), 0x087B814C fill (IWRAM 0x030007A8, veneer 0x0804912C - the slot the previous ticket could not resolve), 0x087B81A0 copy of 2-byte units (IWRAM 0x030007FC, veneer 0x08049144) and 0x087B81FC fill of 2-byte units (IWRAM 0x03000858, veneer 0x08049168). They tile 0x087B810C..0x087B820C with no padding and no literal pool at all - every instruction is register-only - so the pool test is not applicable rather than failed. THE CONTRACT, MEASURED RATHER THAN NAMED: all four take the size in BYTES and move in fixed units (4 bytes and 2 bytes); each has a fast path (eight words = 32 bytes, or eight halfwords = 16 bytes) and a tail entered by a SIZED compare, so the tail RUNS AT LEAST ONCE - a zero-size call still stores one unit - and a size that is not a whole number of units is rounded UP. The fill stores the WHOLE 32-bit value: it replicates r1 into r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8 and ip without masking it to a byte, which is why its callers can pass an ADDRESS as the pattern. 0x087B81A0 enters its unrolled tail through `add pc, pc, r3, lsl #2` with r3 = (16 - size) & 0xE, an offset in PAIRS, so its first pass moves 8 - ((16 - size) & 0xE)/2 halfwords. NO ZERO CHECK and NO ALIGNMENT CHECK is added: reproducing the round-up is the point. THE CALL THAT MADE THIS VISIBLE: sub_08011B04 calls 0x0804912C five times with r0 = object+0x08 / +0x20C / +0x410 / +0x614 / +0x694, r1 = 0x03002A4C / 0x03002A4C / 0x03002A4C / 0x03001C44 / 0xFFFFFFFF and r2 = 0x200 / 0x200 / 0x200 / 0x80 / 0x564, and sub_08011A4E calls 0x08049138 once with r0 = &elements[i], r1 = &elements[i+1], r2 = (count-1-i)*4: a COMPACTION copy, the first call site whose three arguments are all resolved. UNKNOWN: whether the block was authored in C or assembly, and what the non-memory routines of the same block do. No semantic name is assigned and nothing is imported from another title. THE MECHANISM IS NOT OPAQUE AND THE FAMILY IS CENSUSED: the fifteen entries have 450 Thumb BL call sites across the image - 449 confirmed by an aligned chain-walk from 725 evidenced entries, 1 UNKNOWN - and the pattern scan this derivation re-runs on every report agrees with that walk entry for entry. No ARM b/bl/blx anywhere reaches a veneer, no Thumb tail branch does either, and a whole-image search for the 32-bit word of any of the fifteen addresses (and of its odd Thumb form) finds only one unaligned coincidence inside compressed data - so no pointer table, literal pool or vtable holds one and no register-indirect caller is hidden. THE DOMINANT USE OF THE SLOT THIS TICKET EXISTS FOR: of the 125 sites that call 0x0804912C, 118 pass r1 = 0, i.e. a ZERO fill, mostly into VRAM and palette windows; the only pointer-valued fills are the three 0x03002A4C and one 0x03001C44 calls in sub_08011B04 and one 0x03001C44 call in sub_08011D36. The copy at 0x08049144 has the strongest single shape: 28 sites pass r1 = the ROM literal 0x0805652C into 0x05000000 / 0x05000200 for 0x200 bytes, which confirms (destination, source, bytes) from the call sites rather than from the routine's own code. AFTER BOOT the block's CODE half 0x03000000..0x03000F44 is written by nothing that two independent sweeps, every DMA register setup in the image and every absolute store could find; the writers they DO find all land in the 192-byte data tail, the lowest being 0x03000F70. See docs/LIFT_IWRAM_RUNTIME.md sections 2, 3 and 7.

install_routine.notes: r0 is 0x04000000 (mov r0, #64, #12 -> 0x04000000), so the three stores are DMA3SAD 0x040000D4, DMA3DAD 0x040000D8 and DMA3CNT 0x040000DC. The stores carry `ne` only because the flags come from `lsrs`; both counts are non-zero, so both execute.

installed_block.transfer_width_decided_by: the 32-bit reading is the one whose length ends both at the first byte of the 0xFF fill in ROM and at the destination of the first DMA in IWRAM; the 16-bit reading ends in the middle of a function and leaves 3 of the thirteen veneer destinations outside the copied block (0x03000858, 0x03000A4C, 0x03000CA0)

veneer_callers.method: a Thumb BL pattern scan at every two-byte offset of the image, re-decoded from the halfwords. This is an UPPER BOUND: at an offset that is not an instruction boundary four bytes can still spell a BL encoding, so the four-byte-aligned count is reported alongside it and neither is an exact total. An aligned chain-walk from evidenced entries would be authoritative.
veneer_callers.arm_branch_sweep_method: an ARM B/BL is identified from the encoding alone (bits 27-25 of an aligned word equal 0b101), so this sweep is arithmetic rather than a disassembly and has no alignment blind spot. Every site in the family is a Thumb BL caller.

words_naming_the_block_anywhere_in_it.method: every four-byte-aligned offset of the image is read as a little-endian 32-bit word and kept when it lies in [0x03000000, 0x03001004). This is a LOWER BOUND: a second pass at every 2-byte-aligned offset finds 225 values over 533 windows against 129 over 257, the difference being 96 values that occur at an odd offset only. Most of the image is compressed data, where four bytes match a given address by chance, so the per-slot census above is the decision-relevant one and this is a summary.

verdicts_are_independent: SEMANTIC, MODERN_BUILD and ADS_MATCH answer different questions and none is evidence for another. A passing modern build says nothing about the original compiler; a passing semantic run only removes one class of error.

identity.why_not: the original translation unit was built by ARM Developer Suite 1.2 (the surviving command line names tcpp). GCC is a different compiler with a different code generator, so its output cannot establish anything about ADS 1.2.

literal_pools.interpretation: the original's literals are accounted for by the words the unit declares; the modern build pools differently, which is a structural consequence of the compiler rather than a defect in the reconstruction. It is also why a function with a literal load cannot be compared standalone.

comparison.match_claim_note: MEASUREMENT ONLY. This compares a modern GCC build against the cartridge. A modern compiler is not the original compiler, so a difference here is expected and proves nothing; an identity here would also prove nothing about ADS 1.2. ADS_MATCH stays BLOCKED.
